values: 召唤“恒星”并激发场上所有“恒星”造成范围伤害。
Aster summons Stars and supercharges all Stars on the battlefield to deal AoE damage.

使用终极技能时消耗600点能量，选择1个地图格，在对应位置召唤1颗“恒星”，对周围1格范围内的敌人造成360% + 30% ATK伤害。随后激发自身的所有“恒星”，使每颗“恒星”对其周围1格范围内的敌人造成240% + 30% ATK伤害，并眩晕2秒。被激发的“恒星”会进入燃烧状态6秒，期间每秒对周围1格范围内的敌人造成36% + 6% ATK伤害。最多召唤3颗“恒星”。召唤新的“恒星”时，若数量已达上限，则优先替换范围内敌人数量最少的且持续时间最长的“恒星”。每个地图格只能存在1颗自身的“恒星”，自动释放该技能时，将会优先选择敌人最密集且不与自身其它“恒星”重叠的地图格。

Aster consumes 600 Energy to target 1 tile, summoning a Star to deal 360% + 30% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile.
He then supercharges all of his Stars, causing each Star to deal 240% + 30% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile and stun them for 2s. Supercharged Stars burn for 6s, dealing 36% + 6% ATK damage per second to enemies within 1 tile.
Up to 3 of Aster's Stars can exist on the battlefield at the same time. If this limit is reached, summoning a new Star replaces the oldest Star with the fewest enemies in range.
Only 1 of Aster's own Stars can exist on each tile. When cast automatically, this skill prioritizes tiles with the most enemies that do not overlap with any of his other Stars.
“恒星”激发伤害提升至270% + 30% ATK，燃烧伤害提高至每秒42% + 6% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to 270% + 30% ATK, and its burn damage to 42% + 6% ATK per second.
“恒星”激发伤害提升至300% + 30% ATK，燃烧伤害提高至每秒48% + 6% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to 300% + 30% ATK, and its burn damage to 48% + 6% ATK per second.
“恒星”激发伤害提升至330% + 30% ATK，燃烧伤害提高至每秒54% + 6% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to 330% + 30% ATK, and its burn damage to 54% + 6% ATK per second.
“恒星”激发伤害提升至360% + 30% ATK，燃烧伤害提高至每秒60% + 6% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when a Star is supercharged to 360% + 30% ATK, and its burn damage to 60% + 6% ATK per second.
召唤“行星”围绕“恒星”盘旋；主动释放时牵引敌人并造成伤害。
Aster summons a Planet to orbit each Star. When used actively, pulls enemies and deals damage.

被动地，每次召唤“恒星”时，在其相邻格生成1颗“行星”，优先生成在相邻格内生命值最低的敌人所在格。并对该格子上的敌人造成120% ATK伤害。“行星”会以6秒一周的速度围绕对应的“恒星”盘旋，对碰撞到的敌人造成90% ATK伤害，每名敌人每3秒最多受到1次该伤害。每当“行星”完成一周盘旋时，对中心格内的敌人造成180% ATK伤害。主动释放时，操控场上所有“恒星”与“黑洞”，牵引其周围2格范围内的敌人至最近的“恒星”或“黑洞”，并造成270% + 30% ATK伤害。

Passive. Whenever Aster summons a Star, 1 Planet is created on an adjacent tile, prioritizing the tile occupied by the adjacent enemy with the lowest HP. This deals 120% ATK damage to the enemy on that tile.
Each Planet orbits its Star once every 6s, dealing 90% ATK damage to enemies it collides with. An enemy can take this damage 1 time every 3s. Whenever a Planet completes an orbit, it deals 180% ATK damage to enemies on the central tile.
Active. Aster commands all his Stars and Black Holes on the battlefield, pulling enemies within 2 tiles of them toward the nearest Star or Black Hole and dealing 270% + 30% ATK damage.
Increases the pull damage to 300% + 30% ATK.
Increases the pull damage to 330% + 30% ATK.
Increases the pull damage to 360% + 30% ATK.
向敌人数量最多的3条直线发射脉冲射线造成伤害，并基于实际伤害获得护盾。
Aster fires pulse beams along the 3 lines that cover the most enemies, dealing damage and gaining a shield based on actual damage dealt.
分别从3个方向朝覆盖敌人最多的轴线发射脉冲射线，对命中的敌人造成210% + 30% ATK伤害，并获得等同于本技能实际伤害总量90% + 9%的护盾，持续9秒。脉冲射线每次命中敌人时，还会额外击破其护盾，单次最多击破270% + 30% ATK的护盾值。

Aster fires pulse beams along 3 lines that cover the most enemies, dealing 210% + 30% ATK damage to enemies hit. He also gains a shield equal to 90% + 9% of the total actual damage dealt by this skill. The shield lasts 9s. Each time a pulse beam hits an enemy, it also reduces the target's shield value by up to 270% + 30% ATK.
伤害提升至240% + 30% ATK，击破护盾值提升至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 240% + 30% ATK and shield value reduction to 300% + 30% ATK.
伤害提升至270% + 30% ATK，击破护盾值提升至330% + 30% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 270% + 30% ATK and shield value reduction to 330% + 30% ATK.
伤害提升至300% + 30% ATK，击破护盾值提升至360% + 30% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to 300% + 30% ATK and shield value reduction to 360% + 30% ATK.
战斗中提升自身攻击力，召唤“恒星”后额外提升攻击力。
Increases ATK during battle, with each Star summoned providing an extra ATK increase.
战斗中，提升2%的攻击力，每次召唤“恒星”时，额外增加2%的攻击力，最多提升6%。将“恒星”转化为“黑洞”后，额外提升6%的攻击力。
Aster increases his ATK by 2% during battle. Whenever he summons a Star, his ATK increases by an extra 2%, up to 6%. After converting Stars into Black Holes, his ATK increases further by 6%.
战斗中，提升4%的攻击力，每次召唤“恒星”时，额外增加4%的攻击力，最多提升12%。将“恒星”转化为“黑洞”后，额外提升9%的攻击力。
Aster increases his ATK by 4% during battle. Whenever he summons a Star, his ATK increases by an extra 4%, up to 12%. After converting Stars into Black Holes, his ATK increases further by 9%.
战斗中，提升6%的攻击力，每次召唤“恒星”时，额外增加6%的攻击力，最多提升18%。将“恒星”转化为“黑洞”后，额外提升12%的攻击力。
Aster increases his ATK by 6% during battle. Whenever he summons a Star, his ATK increases by an extra 6%, up to 18%. After converting Stars into Black Holes, his ATK increases further by 12%.
将“恒星”转化为“黑洞”，“黑洞”持续造成真实伤害并永久抽取敌人的攻击力和急速。
Aster converts Stars into Black Holes. Black Holes continuously deal true damage and permanently drain enemies' ATK and Haste.

自身召唤的“恒星”数量达到3颗后，将自身的所有“恒星”永久转化为“黑洞”，并吞噬环绕其运动的“行星”。此后通过“星体燃炽”召唤的“恒星”将直接以“黑洞”形态生成。“黑洞”初始每秒对周围1格范围内的敌人造成30% ATK外加目标最大生命值2%的真实伤害（总计不超过60% ATK）。“星体燃炽”激发“黑洞”时，不再使其燃烧，而是使每个“黑洞”分别从范围内的每名敌人处抽取其30%的攻击力和30点急速，敌人失去的属性分别转化为所有“黑洞”的伤害提升和持续伤害频率提升，攻击力提升和持续伤害频率提升的上限分别为60%和60%。且单个敌人因该效果损失的攻击力，累计最高不超过星初始攻击力的60%。

Passive. After summoning 3 Stars, Aster permanently converts all his Stars into Black Holes and devours the Planets orbiting them.
From then on, Stars summoned through Stellar Flare are created directly as Black Holes. Initially, each Black Hole deals 30% ATK true damage plus extra true damage equal to 2% of the target's max HP to enemies within 1 tile every second. The total damage cannot exceed 60% ATK.
When supercharged by Stellar Flare, Black Holes do not burn. Instead, each Black Hole drains 30% ATK and 30 Haste from every enemy within range. The ATK drained increases the damage of all Black Holes, while the Haste drained increases the frequency at which they deal continuous damage. These increases cannot exceed 60% and 60%, respectively. The cumulative ATK a single enemy can lose through this effect cannot exceed 60% of Aster's initial ATK.
“黑洞”对范围内目标造成的真实伤害提高至60% ATK外加目标最大生命值4%（总计不超过120% ATK）。
Increases the true damage dealt by Black Holes to enemies within range to 60% ATK plus 4% of the target's max HP. The total damage cannot exceed 120% ATK.
“黑洞”对范围内目标造成的真实伤害提高至90% ATK外加目标最大生命值6%（总计不超过180% ATK）。
Increases the true damage dealt by Black Holes to enemies within range to 90% ATK plus 6% of the target's max HP. The total damage cannot exceed 180% ATK.
释放“星体燃炽”激发“黑洞”时，额外对范围内的敌人造成180% ATK真实伤害。敌方英雄在“黑洞”范围内被击败时，“黑洞”会将其吞噬，并为星额外回复333点能量。

When a Black Hole is supercharged by Stellar Flare, it deals 180% ATK extra true damage to enemies within range. When an enemy hero is defeated within a Black Hole's range, that Black Hole devours them and restores 333 Energy to Aster.
强化“引力坍缩”的牵引范围和自身回能效率，在“恒星”转化为“黑洞”时进入高维空间，永久处于无敌状态。
Aster increases Gravitic Maw's pull range and his Energy recovery efficiency. When Aster converts his Stars into Black Holes, he ascends to a higher dimension and becomes permanently invincible.
技能“引力坍缩”的牵引范围拓展至3格。在将“恒星”转化为“黑洞”前，自身回能效率提高60%；成功转化时，自身会进入高维空间，永久处于无敌状态，直至战斗中的计入存活的友方英雄仅剩处于此状态的星。

Aster expands Gravitic Maw's pull range to 3 tiles. Aster gains 60% Energy recovery efficiency before converting his Stars into Black Holes. Once converted, he ascends to a higher dimension and becomes permanently invincible until he is the last surviving hero on his team.
